title: kith-tui: owner_user_id silently empty if server omits ownerUserId — outbound messages misclassified as inbound
description: ClientSession.owner_user_id uses #[serde(default)]. If kithd omits ownerUserId from the session response, owner_user_id = '' and sender_id \!= '' treats every message as inbound — owner's own messages get added to unread_message_ids and spurious read receipts are sent. Fix: reject empty owner_user_id early in run_app with a clear error.
